Method of Attack: Deploying Redigo while exploiting a critical security vulnerability, sandbox escape in the Lua scripting engine, for remote code execution. The malware then uses several commands to gain control, replicate the attacking server, and exploit the vulnerability.
Attack Vector: The malware begins by scanning for exposed Redis instances using port 6379. Once an instance is found, it executes commands to gain control and replicate the attacking server. It also configures a connection from the master (the attacking server) to the newly created replica, initiates a replication stream from the master, loads a module from the downloaded dynamic library, and turns the vulnerable Redis server into a master.
Indicators of Compromise: Port 6379 scans for exposed Redis instances
Execution of commands such as INFO, SLAVEOF, REPLCONF, PSYNC, MODULE LOAD, and SLAVEOF NO ONE
Possibility of the compromised servers being used for distributed denial-of-service attacks and cryptocurrency mining attacks
